description: This file defines the class 'InAccessibleEmpNumbers', a validation rule used to determine if an employee number is accessible or not within the HRM system. It includes logic for handling logged-in employee numbers and querying accessible employee IDs based on user roles.

classes.name: InAccessibleEmpNumbers
classes.description: A validation rule class that checks whether a given employee number is accessible to the current user, considering logged-in state and user role permissions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the rule with a flag indicating whether to include the logged-in employee number in access considerations.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates if the input employee number is valid and accessible based on the current user's role and logged-in status.
